source.title: Regels voor het accepteren, verstrekken en wijzigen van een hypotheek
source.disclaimer: SYNTHETIC / SUMMARISED for pipeline testing. Derived from public ASN documentation. Not legal or financial advice. Verify against the live ASN ruleset and NHG norms before any real use.

usage.description: Each rule has a machine-evaluable `check` (when `auto_evaluable` is true) plus pass/fail `examples`. An agent maps the parsed application JSON to field paths, evaluates each rule, and emits a finding.

severity_values.blocking_never_deviate: Hard stop; ASN never deviates. A fail rejects the application.
severity_values.blocking: Must pass; exceptions only via individual maatwerk review.
severity_values.warning: Does not block but needs attention / extra documentation.
severity_values.info: Informational threshold; surface for the adviser.

nhg_scope.without_nhg_only: Only when NHG is not requested.

check_shapes: gating: any check may add only_when/skip_when/stage

rules.description: At application time the applicant must live in a Eurozone country.
rules.remediation: Confirm the applicant lives in a Eurozone country; otherwise ASN cannot lend.

rules.rule_name: Right to live and work in the Netherlands
rules.description: Applicant must be allowed to live and work in NL for the mortgage term when income is needed: Dutch/EU/EEA/Swiss nationality or a qualifying IND permit.

check.expression: EU/EEA/Swiss nationality OR qualifying IND permit

rules.remediation: Provide proof of EU/EEA/Swiss nationality or a qualifying IND residence document.

examples.expected_evidence: Only a temporary permit; not a qualifying document.

rules.description: Applicant must have binding with NL (lives/works in NL or Dutch nationality). Not required if this income is not needed or for NHG.

check.expression: Dutch nationality OR lives/works in NL

rules.remediation: Demonstrate binding via residence/employment in NL.

rules.description: The home must be used primarily for own occupancy, not purely business or investment.
rules.remediation: Confirm owner-occupancy; buy-to-let is not eligible.

rules.description: With two applicants ownership is 50/50, or up to 60/40 if set in notarial conditions before the deed.
rules.remediation: Adjust split to within 60/40 (notarial conditions) or use 50/50.

rules.rule_name: All owners jointly and severally liable
rules.description: All owners must become jointly and severally liable (hoofdelijk schuldenaar) for the whole mortgage.
rules.remediation: Ensure every owner signs as joint and several debtor.

examples.expected_evidence: Not all owners are jointly liable.

rules.description: Applicant must be legally competent (handelingsbekwaam).
rules.remediation: Confirm legal competence; otherwise representation/guardianship rules apply.

rules.description: ASN does not provide a mortgage to an applicant who buys together with family (parents may co-sign as debtor only).
rules.remediation: Restructure so the home is not co-purchased with family.

rules.rule_name: Parent co-signer is debtor, not owner
rules.description: Parents who co-sign do not become owner/occupant but are jointly liable for the whole mortgage.

check.expression: If parent_cosigner: parent is hoofdelijk schuldenaar but not owner/occupant.

rules.remediation: Document parent co-signer as debtor only.

rules.rule_name: Durable relationship and intent to occupy (joint applicants)
rules.description: Joint applicants must have a durable relationship and intent to keep living in the home for the mortgage term.
rules.remediation: Confirm durable relationship for joint applicants.

rules.description: A valid identity document is required and verified for every applicant.
rules.remediation: Provide a valid passport/ID card for every applicant.

rules.description: A BSN must be available for every applicant when the signed offer is returned (may be supplied at signing for privacy).
rules.remediation: Collect the BSN for every applicant before/at offer signing.

examples.expected_evidence: BSN not yet provided (acceptable before signing).

rules.description: The application is screened against internal/external fraud registers (IVR, CHF, VIS, BKR, SFH/EVA).
rules.remediation: Resolve any hit in fraud/integrity registers before proceeding.

rules.description: Special codes A and H, and codes 1-5, are not allowed for financing.
rules.remediation: Prohibited BKR special coding; only a previously accepted coding of an existing customer can be reviewed.

rules.description: Registration types RO/ZO, HY, and SR/SK/SH are not allowed (limited NHG-discharge exceptions for HY/RN).
rules.remediation: Check for the documented NHG-discharge exception; otherwise reject.

rules.rule_name: Eight or more BKR contracts triggers individual review
rules.description: If 8 or more contracts are registered, assess individually and request an explanation of the credit need.
rules.remediation: Request adviser statement on credit need; individual assessment.

rules.rule_name: Foreign credit check for relevant nationals/residents
rules.description: A foreign credit check (CRIF/KSV/SCHUFA/NBB) is required when an applicant is a national of, or lives/works in, IT/AT/DE/BE.

check.expression: If nationality or residence in {IT,AT,DE,BE}: foreign BKR check required.

rules.remediation: Order the relevant foreign credit check.

rules.rule_name: Payment problems at our bank reviewed by Special Servicing
rules.description: Past payment problems / arrears codings at our bank are reviewed by Bijzonder Beheer before acceptance.
rules.remediation: Route to Bijzonder Beheer for individual assessment.

rules.description: Credits or financial obligations held abroad must be disclosed and are taken into account.

check.expression: All foreign credits/obligations disclosed and assessed.

rules.remediation: Request disclosure of any foreign credits.

rules.description: Applicant needs stable, freely disposable income to afford the mortgage, paid to an account in NL, Belgium, or Germany.
rules.remediation: Document stable income via employer's statement / income determination.

rules.rule_name: Temporary contract needs intention statement or perspectiefverklaring
rules.description: Temporary-contract income counts only with an intention statement (post-probation, NHG model) or a Perspectiefverklaring/Arbeidsmarktscan.

check.expression: each temporary applicant: intention_statement OR perspectiefverklaring

rules.remediation: Obtain an intention statement or Perspectiefverklaring.

rules.rule_name: Bonus/overtime capped at 30% of fixed income
rules.description: Structural overtime/bonus/commission over the last 12 months count up to 30% of fixed income, if customary and expected.
rules.remediation: Cap variable income at 30% of fixed income.

rules.rule_name: Foreign income: only fixed income counts
rules.description: When income is earned abroad, only fixed income qualifies as test income.
rules.remediation: Count only fixed foreign income.

rules.description: An agency worker's Perspectiefverklaring requires a minimum recent work history (about 14 months) and a certified agency.

check.expression: Perspectiefverklaring valid: certified agency + >=14 months history.

rules.remediation: Verify the agency certification and work history.

rules.rule_name: Doctor/PhD in training on temporary contract
rules.description: Income of a doctor-in-training (AIOS/ANIOS) or PhD candidate on a temporary contract may count as stable under specific rules.

check.expression: AIOS/ANIOS/PhD temporary income assessed as stable per Ch.3.3.

rules.remediation: Apply the dedicated assessment for trainees.

rules.description: A fixed, unconditional salary increase starting within 6 months may be included.

check.expression: Unconditional increase starting <=6 months may be added to fixed income.

rules.remediation: Include only if documented and unconditional.

rules.description: Income from pension, AOW, or a guaranteed lifelong annuity counts as fixed income.

check.expression: Pension/AOW/guaranteed lifelong annuity counts as fixed income.

rules.remediation: Provide pension overview / decision letters.

rules.description: Income from WAO, WAZ, IVA, and Wajong counts as fixed income.
rules.remediation: Provide benefit decision letters.

rules.description: Income with an end date is treated under specific rules and may need robust income elsewhere.

check.expression: Income with end date assessed per Ch.3.6.

rules.remediation: Identify the end date and assess continuation.

rules.rule_name: Employed under 3 months needs UWV + contract
rules.description: If an applicant is employed < 3 months (or has a second job), the UWV-verzekeringsbericht and employment contract are required.
rules.remediation: Request the UWV-verzekeringsbericht and contract.

rules.rule_name: Rental income is not standard test income
rules.description: Income from rent is only counted under specific conditions.

check.expression: Rental income only counted per Ch.3.9 conditions.

rules.remediation: Assess rental income against the specific rules.

rules.rule_name: Expense allowances excluded from test income
rules.description: Components meant for expenses/training are not freely disposable and are excluded from test income.

check.expression: Exclude expense/training allowances from test income.

rules.remediation: Strip non-disposable components from income.

rules.description: Self-employed test income = average over last 3 book years, capped at the most recent year.
rules.remediation: Provide 3 full book years of figures.

rules.description: Active < 36 months: >=24 months -> 90% of average; >=12 months -> 75%. At least 1 full book year required.
rules.remediation: Provide >=1 full book year + accountant prognosis; apply 75%/90% haircut.

rules.rule_name: No income from a foreign-based business
rules.description: ASN never establishes income from a business based abroad.
rules.remediation: Foreign-based business income cannot be used.

rules.description: For a business with legal personality the current ratio must be >= 1.
rules.remediation: Improve liquidity or supply evidence supporting the ratio.

rules.description: For a business with legal personality the solvency must be >= 20%.
rules.remediation: Improve solvency or supply supporting evidence.

rules.description: The business must have a simple legal structure of at most 3 entities.
rules.remediation: Provide consolidated reports; complex structures may be rejected.

rules.description: With more than 2 minority participations the structure is complex and no business income is established.
rules.remediation: No business income with >2 minority participations.

rules.rule_name: Dividend not above profit after tax
rules.description: Distributed dividend counted may not exceed profit after corporate tax in the same year, with accountant confirmation.

check.expression: counted dividend <= profit after corporate tax; accountant confirms no harm to operations.

rules.remediation: Provide accountant confirmation for dividend.

rules.description: If the applicant also has a salaried job of >=32h, business test income may not exceed 30% of the salaried annual income.

check.expression: if salaried_hours >= 32: business_income <= 30% of salaried annual income.

rules.remediation: Cap business income at 30% of salaried income.

rules.rule_name: Assessment statement when business income not needed
rules.description: If business income is not needed, a beoordelingsverklaring must confirm the business can be left out (losses may correct income).

check.expression: beoordelingsverklaring required when KvK registration income not used.

rules.remediation: Obtain a beoordelingsverklaring.

rules.description: Financing burden may not exceed the allowed burden (NIBUD/Trhk).
rules.remediation: Reduce loan/obligations so burden is within the allowed burden.

rules.description: The financing burden is always determined on an annuity basis over max 30 years, regardless of repayment type.

check.expression: Burden computed as annuity over <=30 years using the test rate.

rules.remediation: Apply the annuity test method.

rules.description: Test rate = offer rate if fixed-rate period >= 120 months; otherwise the higher of the offer rate or the AFM test rate.

check.expression: RVP>=120m: test rate = offer rate; RVP<120m: max(offer rate, AFM test rate).

rules.remediation: Use the correct test rate for the fixed-rate period.

rules.description: Allowed burden uses the annual NIBUD financing-burden percentages from the Trhk, based on the highest test income and weighted test rate.

check.expression: Use NIBUD percentages from the Trhk for the relevant year.

rules.remediation: Apply current NIBUD percentages.

rules.rule_name: Revolving credit test charge 2% of limit
rules.description: A revolving credit (doorlopend krediet) is tested at 2% of the limit per month.

check.expression: revolving credit test charge = 2% of limit/month.

rules.remediation: Apply 2% of the limit as the monthly test charge.

rules.description: A reducing-balance BKR credit is tested at the registered amount divided by the term (actual charge).

check.expression: aflopend krediet test charge = BKR amount / term.

rules.remediation: Apply registered amount divided by term.

rules.description: Operational car lease is the BKR amount / term; BKR registrations before 1-4-2022 are corrected by dividing by 0.65.

check.expression: operational lease: BKR amount/term; pre-2022 registrations / 0.65.

rules.remediation: Apply the 0.65 correction for pre-2022 lease registrations.

rules.description: Partner alimony payable is deducted from the applicant's test income before applying the percentage.

check.expression: partner alimony payable reduces test income.

rules.remediation: Deduct partner alimony from test income.

rules.rule_name: Child alimony not deducted from income
rules.description: Child alimony payable is not deducted from test income.

check.expression: child alimony NOT deducted from test income.

rules.remediation: Do not deduct child alimony from income.

rules.description: An annual leasehold canon (erfpachtcanon) is taken into account as an obligation at its annual amount.
rules.remediation: Include the annual canon as an obligation.

rules.rule_name: Student debt tested at the term amount (DUO)
rules.description: A DUO student debt is tested at the term amount (grossed up under the Trhk where interest is deductible).

check.expression: student debt test charge = DUO term amount (grossed per Trhk).

rules.remediation: Apply the DUO term amount as the test charge.

rules.description: No account is taken of an interest-only period or income-based reduction; the annuity term amount on the current debt/rate/term is used.

check.expression: ignore aflosvrije periode / draagkracht reduction; use annuity on current debt.

rules.remediation: Compute the annuity term amount on current debt/rate/term.

rules.description: A family loan may be left out of the allowed burden only if it meets all leen-/schenk conditions (parents in private, written, market rate fixed >=10y, annuity/linear <=30y, within annual gift exemption, not callable).

check.expression: family loan excluded only if all leen-/schenk conditions are met.

rules.remediation: Verify each leen-/schenk condition.

rules.description: Double housing charges must be affordable within the allowed burden; otherwise own funds must cover them (existing build 6 months; new build 12-24 months).

check.expression: double charges within allowed burden or covered by own funds.

rules.remediation: Demonstrate affordability or sufficient own funds for double charges.

rules.rule_name: Own funds above EUR 15,000 must be proven
rules.description: Own funds above EUR 15,000 (and always for NHG) must be evidenced.

check.expression: own funds > 15,000 (or any for NHG) must be proven.

rules.remediation: Provide evidence of own funds.

rules.rule_name: Foreign currency and crypto excluded as own funds
rules.description: Foreign currency and cryptocurrency are never counted as own funds.

check.expression: own funds not in crypto/foreign currency

rules.remediation: Convert/replace with eligible own funds.

examples.expected_evidence: Crypto not counted as own funds.

rules.description: Other (non-own-home) mortgages are tested at their annuity charge, or 2% of the original principal per month if data is insufficient.

check.expression: other mortgage test charge = annuity charge or 2% of original principal.

rules.remediation: Provide details of other mortgages.

rules.description: Optional debt-to-income proxy for pipelines supplying a DTI; ASN uses NIBUD burden, not a flat DTI.
rules.remediation: If DTI is high, rely on the NIBUD burden test (AFF-001).

rules.description: A residual debt can be financed only if it arose less than 1 year before the new application (transfer date).
rules.remediation: Residual debt older than 1 year cannot be co-financed.

rules.rule_name: Residual debt term max 15 years, linear
rules.description: Residual-debt financing has a max term of 15 years and must be repaid linearly, fully using the available burden.
rules.remediation: Set the residual-debt term to <=15 years, linear repayment.

rules.rule_name: External residual debt capped at EUR 30,000
rules.description: Financing a residual debt that did not arise at an ASN brand is capped at EUR 30,000.
rules.remediation: Cap external residual-debt financing at EUR 30,000.

rules.rule_name: WOZ valuation not allowed with bridging
rules.description: A WOZ valuation is never allowed to value the home to be sold when a bridging loan is requested.

check.expression: WOZ valuation forbidden for sold-home value when bridging.

rules.remediation: Use a validated valuation or sale price instead.

rules.description: ASN finances only a home located in the Netherlands.
rules.remediation: Property must be in NL.

rules.description: The home must be zoned by the municipality for permanent habitation.
rules.remediation: Confirm permanent residential zoning.

rules.description: The home must not be located on a commercial or industrial estate.
rules.remediation: Property cannot be on a commercial/industrial estate.

rules.description: The home must stand on clean (non-contaminated) ground.
rules.remediation: Provide evidence of clean soil.

rules.description: The home must be permanently fixed with its own foundation (cannot roll or float).
rules.remediation: Only fixed homes with own foundation are eligible.

rules.description: The home must have a marketability (courantheid) of at most 12 months.
rules.remediation: Property must be sellable within 12 months.

rules.description: The home must have a minimum living area of 30 m2.
rules.remediation: Homes under 30 m2 are not eligible.

rules.description: The land must not carry unacceptable easements or leasehold conditions.
rules.remediation: Resolve or clarify any unacceptable easements.

rules.description: The home must be fully self-contained: own front door, kitchen, toilet, and bathroom.
rules.remediation: Only fully self-contained dwellings are eligible.

rules.rule_name: Owner changed within 12 months -> extra investigation
rules.description: If the home changed owner in the 12 months before transfer, extra investigation is required (except inheritance/foundation buy-back).
rules.remediation: Perform extra investigation into the recent ownership change.

rules.description: The whole home's building condition must be at least reasonable per the valuation; otherwise a structural report and bouwdepot are required.

check.expression: building condition >= reasonable, else bouwkundig rapport + bouwdepot.

rules.remediation: Provide a structural report and reserve maintenance in a bouwdepot.

rules.rule_name: Poor element threshold EUR 2,500 to bouwdepot
rules.description: If a single element is poor/moderate, the estimated direct cost is reserved in a bouwdepot above a EUR 2,500 threshold.

check.expression: poor element cost reserved in bouwdepot above EUR 2,500.

rules.remediation: Reserve the estimated repair cost in a bouwdepot.

rules.rule_name: Apartment requires active VVE and reserves
rules.description: For an apartment there must be an active VVE with a long-term maintenance plan and an annual reservation of at least 0.5% of rebuild value.
rules.remediation: Provide proof of an active VVE, MJOP, and reserves.

rules.description: New build requires a definitive environmental permit (omgevingsvergunning).
rules.remediation: Obtain the definitive omgevingsvergunning.

rules.description: Project-built new homes require a completion guarantee / warranty certificate (afbouwgarantie/waarborgcertificaat).
rules.remediation: Provide afbouwgarantie/waarborgcertificaat for project build.

rules.description: CPO without warranty: max 80% LTV (and 80% income-based) with CAR insurance for the whole build.
rules.remediation: Cap CPO LTV at 80% and arrange CAR insurance.

rules.description: Prefab without warranty: max 90% income-based, builder affiliated to Bouwgarant/Woningborg, payment afterward, CAR insurance.

check.expression: prefab: <=90% income norm, Bouwgarant/Woningborg, pay after delivery, CAR.

rules.remediation: Verify prefab conditions.

rules.description: Bouw in eigen beheer / zelfbouw without warranty: max 80% LTV with a building budget and CAR insurance.
rules.remediation: Cap LTV at 80% with building budget and CAR insurance.

rules.description: Cooperative ownership requires an own membership right pledged by notarial deed, an association of >=25 apartments, and professional management.
rules.remediation: Verify cooperative association size and governance.

rules.rule_name: No additional/bridge loan on cooperative ownership
rules.description: A higher inschrijving, follow-up, or bridging mortgage is never possible with cooperative ownership.

check.expression: no higher inschrijving/vervolg/overbrugging for cooperative ownership.

rules.remediation: These products are not available for cooperative ownership.

rules.description: Kangaroo/care homes are financed only as 2 self-contained units on 1 cadastral whole owned by 1 owner (or 2 with a durable relationship).

check.expression: kangaroo/care home: 2 units, 1 cadastral whole, single owner who can pay.

rules.remediation: Verify single ownership of the combined property.

rules.description: With partial business/agricultural zoning the residential part must be >=60% of total market value (split NWWI valuation); business part financed max 70%.
rules.remediation: Provide a split NWWI valuation; finance the business part at <=70%.

rules.description: ASN does not lend when there is a pre-agreed mandatory/minimum buy-back price for the land.
rules.remediation: Mandatory land buy-back constructions are not eligible.

rules.description: For government-issued leasehold, the canon must be fixed for at least 10 more years, or the new canon must be known.

check.expression: government erfpacht: canon fixed >=10y or new canon known.

rules.remediation: Confirm canon fixity or the future canon level.

rules.description: Private leasehold needs a green erfpacht opinion (pre-2013) or KNB-model perpetual conditions (post-2013), with future canon known.

check.expression: private erfpacht: green opinion (pre-2013) or KNB model perpetual (post-2013).

rules.remediation: Provide the erfpacht opinion / KNB-conform conditions.

rules.description: A Groninger akte is accepted only if no other dissolving/suspensive conditions are attached to the purchase (notary verifies).

check.expression: Groninger akte accepted if no other conditions remain at transfer.

rules.remediation: Confirm no other purchase conditions remain.

rules.description: Buyer-support constructions are accepted only with NHG and NHG approval of the construction at the binding offer.

check.expression: koperssteun: NHG requested and construction NHG-approved.

rules.remediation: Confirm NHG approval of the construction.

rules.description: A valuation report is mandatory for a recreational home.
rules.remediation: Provide a valuation report for the recreational home.

rules.description: A recreational home may be financed up to 70% of market value.
rules.remediation: Cap recreational LTV at 70%.

rules.description: A recreational-home mortgage must be repaid fully on an annuity or linear basis.
rules.remediation: Use annuity/linear repayment for recreational homes.

rules.rule_name: No bridging on a recreational home
rules.description: A bridging loan on a recreational home is not possible.

check.expression: no bridging loan secured on a recreational home.

rules.remediation: Bridging is not available for recreational homes.

rules.description: A recreational home must be of stone (or wood if built >=2020), non-movable, and connected to water and electricity, with recreational zoning.

check.expression: recreational home: stone (or wood >=2020), fixed, utilities connected, recreational zoning.

rules.remediation: Verify construction, connections, and zoning.

rules.description: A validated NWWI valuation report is required when the total mortgage on the home exceeds EUR 1,000,000.
rules.remediation: Provide a validated NWWI valuation report.

rules.description: If validation of the valuation report is possible, it is mandatory.

check.expression: if validation possible -> validated report required.

rules.remediation: Use a validated valuation report.

rules.description: Calcasa desktop valuation is allowed only if the total mortgage is <= EUR 1,000,000, the home is >= 2 years old, there is no leasehold/opstal, and the application fits the standard norm.

check.expression: Calcasa allowed: <=1,000,000, home >=2y, no erfpacht/opstal, standaardnorm.

rules.remediation: Use a full valuation if Calcasa conditions are not met.

rules.description: With a Calcasa desktop valuation the total mortgage may not exceed 90% of the assessed market value.
rules.remediation: Cap LTV at 90% when using Calcasa, or get a full valuation.

rules.rule_name: Purchase price below market -> price is basis
rules.description: If the purchase price is below the appraised market value, the purchase price is the basis (value after renovation if applicable); tariff group uses appraised value.

check.expression: if koopsom < market value: use koopsom as basis.

rules.remediation: Use the purchase price as the financing basis.

rules.description: For an auction purchase the appraised market value is the basis; surplus is held in a bouwdepot for quality improvement.

check.expression: auction: appraised value basis; surplus to bouwdepot.

rules.remediation: Hold surplus in a bouwdepot for improvements.

rules.description: Value after renovation is used only if it follows from a valuation report; otherwise the pre-renovation value applies, with funds held in a bouwdepot.

check.expression: post-renovation value only from valuation; else pre-renovation value.

rules.remediation: Provide a valuation stating the after-renovation value.

rules.rule_name: Bouwdepot pays only on proof of payment
rules.description: Funds are paid from the bouwdepot only against a valid proof of payment, never against quotes.

check.expression: bouwdepot payments only against invoices/receipts, not quotes.

rules.remediation: Submit invoices/receipts for bouwdepot payments.

rules.description: An invoice/receipt may not be older than 6 months when submitted; for NHG it must be dated after the application date.

check.expression: invoice <=6 months old (NHG: after application date).

rules.remediation: Submit invoices within 6 months.

rules.description: Prepayments from a bouwdepot are capped at EUR 5,000 (kitchens/bathrooms: 15% of purchase, max EUR 5,000).
rules.remediation: Cap prepayments at EUR 5,000.

rules.description: Bouwdepot duration: 1 year for existing build (auto +1y), 2 years for new build (extendable by 1y).
rules.remediation: Track the bouwdepot term and remaining balance.

rules.description: The interest rate is not adjusted during the bouwdepot term.

check.expression: no rate change during bouwdepot term.

rules.remediation: Rate is fixed for the bouwdepot term.

rules.rule_name: Leftover energy reservation must be repaid
rules.description: Any remaining reserved energy-saving funds may not be reused and must be repaid on the mortgage.

check.expression: remaining energy reservation repaid, not reused.

rules.remediation: Repay leftover energy funds on the mortgage.

rules.rule_name: Interest-financing account max 2 years, separate part
rules.description: A rentefinancieringsrekening (new build only) lasts max 2 years and is always a separate loan part.
rules.remediation: Set up the interest-financing account as a separate loan part.

rules.description: The total mortgage may never exceed EUR 3,000,000 (bridging excluded).
rules.remediation: Reduce the loan to at most EUR 3,000,000.

rules.description: The mortgage term is minimum 5 and maximum 30 years (individual parts may be shorter).
rules.remediation: Set the term within 5-30 years.

rules.description: ASN never lends behind a mortgage that is not held at one of its brands.
rules.remediation: A follow-up requires an existing ASN-brand first mortgage.

rules.description: A regular mortgage may not exceed 100% of market value unless the sustainability uplift applies.
rules.remediation: Reduce to <=100% or qualify for the 106% uplift.

rules.description: With sustainability measures the LTV may go up to 106% of market value.
rules.remediation: Confirm the sustainability quotation; cap at 106%.

rules.description: When financing a residual debt the LTV may go up to 110%.
rules.remediation: Residual-debt LTV is capped at 110%.

rules.rule_name: Loans over EUR 2,000,000 capped at 90% LTV
rules.description: Mortgages above EUR 2,000,000 have a maximum LTV of 90%.
rules.remediation: Reduce LTV to <=90% for loans above EUR 2M.

rules.description: Interest-only loan parts are limited to 50% of market value (40% under maatwerk).
rules.remediation: Reduce the interest-only portion to <=50%.

rules.description: A consumer-purpose (consumptief) draw has a maximum LTV of 90% and must fit the standard norm.
rules.remediation: Cap consumer-purpose draws at 90% LTV.

rules.rule_name: Bridging requires a first mortgage >= EUR 50,000
rules.description: A bridging loan is offered only with a first mortgage of at least EUR 50,000.
rules.remediation: Ensure a qualifying first mortgage accompanies the bridge.

rules.description: A bridging loan has a maximum term of 2 years.
rules.remediation: Cap the bridging term at 2 years.

rules.description: Bridging amount is based on 99% of the sale price (definitively sold) or 95% of the appraised value (not yet sold).

check.expression: bridging: 99% of sale price if sold, else 95% of appraised value.

rules.remediation: Apply the correct bridging percentage.

rules.description: A pure refinance is allowed up to 100% of value if the annuity test charge fits the allowed burden; otherwise up to 80%.

check.expression: pure refinance: 100% if annuity charge fits; else 80%.

rules.remediation: Confirm the annuity charge fits, else cap at 80%.

rules.description: Refinancing from non-NHG to NHG requires >=10% extra linear/annuity repayment, or a renovation of >= EUR 2,500, or it being needed to keep the home.

check.expression: refinance to NHG: +10% repayment OR >=2,500 renovation OR home retention.

rules.remediation: Meet one of the refinance-to-NHG conditions.

rules.description: Refinancing a loan for business purposes is never allowed.
rules.remediation: Business-loan refinancing is not permitted.

rules.rule_name: Refinanced consumer credit repaid in <=10 years
rules.description: Refinanced consumer credits must be repaid on annuity/linear basis within 10 years.
rules.remediation: Set the refinanced consumer-credit term to <=10 years.

rules.rule_name: Bank guarantee only with our mortgage
rules.description: A bank guarantee is issued only when the mortgage is taken out with us.

check.expression: bank guarantee only if mortgage is with us.

rules.remediation: Bank guarantee requires an ASN mortgage.

rules.description: Existing customers may finance up to 50% interest-only if the post-financing LTV is <=50% (not for credit refinancing).

check.expression: existing customers: interest-only up to 50% if resulting LTV <= 50%.

rules.remediation: Verify the resulting LTV and customer tenure.

rules.description: Maatwerk (deviation from the standard norm) is not possible for mortgages above EUR 1,250,000.
rules.remediation: Maatwerk is unavailable above EUR 1,250,000.

rules.description: Under maatwerk an interest-only loan part is allowed up to 40% of market value (50% in specific cases).
rules.remediation: Cap interest-only at 40% under maatwerk.

rules.description: When LTV >= 80%, at least 80% of test income must be fixed and stable; otherwise maatwerk is not possible.
rules.remediation: Increase the share of fixed/stable income or reduce LTV.

examples.expected_evidence: Insufficient fixed income at high LTV.

rules.description: Maatwerk with release of joint liability is only possible if the current mortgage has run >=12 months at an ASN brand.
rules.remediation: Wait until the mortgage has run >=12 months at an ASN brand.

rules.description: For seniors with an AOW gap tested on actual charges, the fixed-rate period must be at least 10 years (and last to the youngest applicant's AOW date).
rules.remediation: Set the fixed-rate period to >=10 years for AOW-gap cases.

rules.rule_name: Seniors buying another home: fixed-rate >= 20 years
rules.description: Seniors buying another home and tested on actual charges need a fixed-rate period of at least 20 years (max 80% LTV without NHG).
rules.remediation: Set the fixed-rate period to >=20 years.

rules.description: A Calcasa desktop valuation is not allowed in combination with maatwerk.
rules.remediation: Use a validated NWWI valuation under maatwerk.

rules.rule_name: WOZ valuation only to lower tariff group
rules.description: A WOZ valuation may be used only to lower the tariff group, up to 75% of WOZ value (85% of WOZ used as market value).

check.expression: WOZ valuation only for tariff-group lowering; up to 75% WOZ.

rules.remediation: Use WOZ only for tariff-group reductions.

rules.description: If a customer has not paid on time (with us or elsewhere), a change request may be rejected and routed to Bijzonder Beheer.
rules.remediation: Resolve arrears; Bijzonder Beheer assesses if active.

rules.description: Changing the repayment form to interest-only is treated as a new mortgage (full income and value testing).
rules.remediation: Apply full acceptance rules for switches to interest-only.

rules.description: A co-debtor can be released only if the remaining customer obtains full ownership, has 5 years of clean payments, and has sufficient income.

check.expression: release: full ownership + 5y clean payments + sufficient income.

rules.remediation: Verify ownership, payment history, and income.

rules.description: The value for a joint-liability release must come from a validated NWWI valuation (Calcasa only if the divorce settlement used it).

check.expression: joint-liability release value from NWWI taxatie (Calcasa only per settlement).

rules.remediation: Provide a validated NWWI valuation.

rules.rule_name: New debtor equal share, no arrears
rules.description: A new partner joining as owner/debtor must take an equal ownership share and have no payment arrears.

check.expression: new debtor: equal share + no arrears + KYC.

rules.remediation: Verify equal share and clean credit for the new debtor.

rules.description: If the surviving partner stays in the home, the mortgage may continue if that partner can afford the monthly charges.

check.expression: surviving partner must afford the monthly charges.

rules.remediation: Test the surviving partner's affordability.

rules.description: An heir taking over the home from other heirs is fully tested on income and value (with KYC).

check.expression: heir takeover -> full acceptance testing + KYC.

rules.remediation: Apply full acceptance rules to heir takeovers.

rules.rule_name: Repay within 1 year of death without penalty
rules.description: On death of the debtor/cohabiting partner, the mortgage may be (partly) repaid within 1 year without an early-repayment penalty.

check.expression: repayment within 1 year of death is penalty-free.

rules.remediation: Allow penalty-free repayment within 1 year of death.

rules.description: At the mortgage end date a new mortgage may finance up to 50% interest-only even outside the standard norm (absolute amount may not grow).

check.expression: end-date refinance: interest-only <= 50%; absolute amount not larger.

rules.remediation: Cap interest-only at 50% on end-date refinance.

rules.rule_name: Bridging extension only for existing build
rules.description: A bridging loan for new build (2y) cannot be extended; existing build (1y) can be extended by max 1 year under conditions.

check.expression: new-build bridge not extendable; existing-build +1y under conditions.

rules.remediation: Verify build type and extension conditions.

rules.description: For the legacy Belgium mortgage, a replacement loan must be fully amortising with a max term of 25 years.

check.expression: Belgium mortgage replacement: fully amortising, term <= 25 years.

rules.remediation: Structure a fully amortising loan within 25 years.

rules.rule_name: No permanent rental of the home
rules.description: The home may not be rented out permanently; only temporary (Leegstandswet) or temporary recreational rental is allowed.
rules.remediation: Permanent rental is not allowed; obtain consent for temporary rental.

rules.description: Temporary recreational rental needs prior written consent: home remains main residence, <=60 days/year, never >4 weeks consecutively, with suitable insurance.
rules.remediation: Limit recreational rental to <=60 days/year with consent.

rules.description: Allowing a second mortgage charge behind ours requires a risk assessment including a BKR check; it may be refused.

check.expression: second charge: risk assessment + BKR check; may refuse.

rules.remediation: Perform a risk assessment for the second charge.

rules.description: Partial release: <5 m2 needs no income/value test; 5 m2-10% may use Calcasa if LTV<90%; larger needs an NWWI report before/after.

check.expression: partial release thresholds: <5m2 none; <10% Calcasa if LTV<90%; else NWWI.

rules.remediation: Apply the partial-release thresholds.

rules.description: Converting cooperative ownership to an apartment right is accepted without retesting only if the mortgage is not increased/changed.

check.expression: coop->apartment right: no retest if no increase/change.

rules.remediation: Confirm no mortgage increase accompanies the conversion.

rules.description: Lowering the repayment target requires income and value testing per the acceptance rules.

check.expression: lowering repayment target -> income + value testing.

rules.remediation: Apply acceptance testing for a lower repayment target.

rules.description: Selling the home and repaying from the proceeds is penalty-free, unless the customer chose the 'penalty on moving' budget option.

check.expression: sale repayment penalty-free unless 'boete bij verhuizen' chosen.

rules.remediation: Check the budget-option election for penalties.

rules.description: A valid identity document is required for every applicant (Wwft).
rules.remediation: Provide a valid passport/ID card for every applicant.

rules.description: A werkgeversverklaring is required for salaried applicants.
rules.remediation: Provide the employer's statement for each salaried applicant.

rules.description: Recent salary slips (loonstrook) are required for salaried income.
rules.remediation: Provide recent salary slips.

rules.description: A UWV-verzekeringsbericht is required for employment <3 months, a second job, or a temporary contract.
rules.remediation: Request the UWV-verzekeringsbericht.

rules.description: A valuation (validated taxatierapport, or Calcasa where allowed) is required.
rules.remediation: Provide a validated valuation report.

rules.description: Income verification needs salary slips and the annual statement (jaaropgave).
rules.remediation: Request the missing income documents (jaaropgave / tax returns).

rules.description: A signed purchase agreement (koopovereenkomst) is required for a purchase.
rules.remediation: Provide the signed purchase agreement.

rules.description: Recent bank statements are required to assess the financial situation.
rules.remediation: Provide recent bank statements.

rules.description: Self-employed applicants must provide annual figures / tax returns to establish income.
rules.remediation: Provide annual accounts / tax returns.

rules.description: When the sustainability uplift is used, an energy label and sustainability quotation must support the extra amount.
rules.remediation: Provide the sustainability quotation/energy label.

rules.description: Optional FICO-style score gate for pipelines supplying a numeric score; NL practice relies on BKR.
rules.remediation: If a numeric score is low, rely on the BKR assessment.
